title: The Build Lines entry point is hidden for a Work Orders View-only role
custom_preconds:
1. ShopCoach is turned on for the organization.
  2. A custom role 'WO View Only' exists (Work orders View ON, Work order lines Create & Edit OFF) with a user.
  3. At least one work order exists.

custom_steps_separated.content: Log in as the WO View Only user and open a work order's Lines tab.
custom_steps_separated.expected: The work order opens (status badge shown) and the in-page ShopCoach Line Builder panel is not shown.

custom_steps_separated.content: If the New Line dialog can be opened, open it.
custom_steps_separated.expected: The Build Lines button is not shown.

evidence: UI (WO View-only role): the Build Lines entry point is not shown (buildLines=false).
